name: qr-code-scanner
title: QR Code Scanner
description: Scan QR codes on your screen with macOS Vision. Works in Raycast and Raycast-compatible launchers.
author: chen86860

commands.name: scan-qr-code
commands.title: Scan QR Code
commands.description: Select an area (or capture every display) and decode the QR code in it.

preferences.name: captureMode
preferences.title: Capture Mode
preferences.description: Select an area for precise recognition, or scan every display.

preferences.name: silence
preferences.title: Silence Mode
preferences.label: Do Not Play Sound
preferences.description: Do not play the shutter sound when capturing the screen.

preferences.name: openUrlAfterScan
preferences.title: Open URL After Scan
preferences.label: Open URL Automatically
preferences.description: Open decoded URLs automatically after scanning. Disable to copy or inspect links first.
